I added a page to your Reading log. I haven't opened it in Amber Notes, so I haven't seen how it looks. Your table and the "Want to read" line are unchanged.

- **Cover cards:** each book gets a colored cover with its title and author, plus star rating and finish date underneath. The color comes from the title. Newest books come first.
- **Average rating:** shown as a number with stars. It's 4.2 across your 5 books.
- **Books per month:** a bar chart running from your first month to your latest. Months with no books show as empty bars.
- **Add a book:** I also put a small form at the bottom that adds a row to the table. You didn't ask for it.

The page reads from the table, so new rows show up in the cards and stats.
